def min_bridge_downtime(N, arrival_times):
    # Convert arrival times to minutes for easier calculations
    arrival_times = [t // 60 for t in arrival_times]
    
    # Initialize DP array where dp[i] represents the end time of the last operation on the bridge up to the ith boat
    dp = [float('inf')] * (N + 1)
    dp[0] = 0
    
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        # Option 1: Lower the bridge immediately after the previous boat leaves
        if dp[i-1] + 1 <= arrival_times[i]:
            dp[i] = dp[i-1] + 1
        
        # Option 2: Raise the bridge immediately before the current boat arrives
        if i > 1 and dp[i-2] + 2 <= arrival_times[i]:
            dp[i] = min(dp[i], dp[i-2] + 2)
        
        # Option 3: Keep the bridge raised until the next boat is expected to arrive
        if i > 1 and dp[i-2] + 2 <= arrival_times[i-1] + 1:
            dp[i] = min(dp[i], dp[i-2] + 2)
    
    # Convert the final downtime back to seconds
    return max(0, dp[N] * 60)
